strings.§7.xd key <API Key> §f- 设置 DeepSeek 密钥（只: §7.xd key <API key> §f- set the DeepSeek key (stored locally)
strings.§7.xd owner <你的ID> §f- 指定要跟的人: §7.xd owner <your name> §f- who it listens to
strings.§7.xd enchant <物品>[,附魔] §f- 附魔，可刷到想要的附魔（: §7.xd enchant <item>[,enchant] §f- enchant, rerolling until it matches
strings.§7.xd sethome | home [clear] §f- 把床/脚底下设: §7.xd sethome | home [clear] §f- set home at your bed/feet (sleeping does it too)
strings.§7.xd protect [64|on|off] §f- 家的保护区边心距（默: §7.xd protect [64|on|off] §f- home protection apothem (default 64 = 128x128, interact only)
